rawContent: @CornellWBrooks @latimes @AP Agree. How does the narrative gets controlled by those directly impacted? #BlackLivesMatter lost the narrative when Trump labeled it negatively as unpatriotic violence in America and kneeling in protest anti-American to the flag.

I refuse to be angry about issues, I'd rather organize. I refuse to be downcast about bigotry, I'd rather #educate. I refuse to be overwhelmed by discrimination, I'll become an activist for change. We are the change we seek.  #BlackLivesMatter #MarchForOurLives #GunControlNow

@BlackChuckTodd @tariqnasheed Agree. Don't you think the big tent should include Latinos, and Mexican immigrants embracing our issues also? It shouldn't be one-sided. #BlackLivesMatter didn't see them on the streets marching. The tent isn't strong without unity from all.
